ratings_why.fun: Banking Rest so every buff lands twice, and the hoard vs. wake split, are good to draft, but every unit carries a counter and the payoff waits a long time.
ratings_why.distinct: Rest as a doubler that fits on any unit, plus lending drowsiness to the enemy, plays unlike today's tribes and unlike a plain stat-stacker.

verdict_why: The timing and 'permanent' wording the Wake chain depends on are not stated, and a revision can fix that without changing the idea.

points.text: The rules don't say whether Sleepers gain their 2 Rest before or after cards' End of Turn effects. The Wake chain (Vespers Bat, then Old Polh using up the Rest) works only one way round, so say which.

Rest is spent only on 'permanent' gains, but Lamplighter Hrošč, Old Polh, Cowbell Kurent and the Prior don't say permanently. A player can't tell which of their buffs get doubled; add the word where it applies.
Pool Olmling's Wake gives +1/+1 and 3 Rest: does the Rest come first and double the +1/+1, or after? Write the order.
Splitting the doubling Health-first, one Rest per point, is hard to do in your head. 'A gain on a unit with Rest is doubled and uses 1 Rest' would read at a glance and still be a real cost.
The Eldest quietly turns off Wakes from buffs. Saying so on the card ('your units don't Wake from gains') would show the player that the two builds split here.

standouts.why: The Robber-Knight lends your sleepiness to the enemy, so they lose Attack. A buff resource turned into a debuff that fits his story of gifts to his besiegers, and it reads in one line.
Hanging Horseshoe Bat hunkers while it sleeps, like a bat wrapped in its wings. Tiny text, the fantasy shows in what it does, and the Dragon flooding the Rest away makes a real choice.
Dragon of the Springs floods out the stored Rest at Start of Combat, which is the seed's flood bringing the deep to the surface, and it is a clear payoff for the hoard build.

weakest.why: Lamplighter Hrošč is a generic End of Turn buff. The lamps nobody can see could do something about Rest or about not being seen.
Dark-Sensing Olm does the expected count-and-gain, and you have to read the Rest on its neighbours before the Dragon empties them.
Gift-Shop Friar, gold per 4 Rest on a sale, is a sum to work out every sale and goes against the tribe's 'keep it' fantasy.

flags.note: With The Eldest, Rest never runs out, so every permanent buff is doubled forever; with a share-of-stats grower from another tribe this could compound.
Ribica's copies count towards triples, so the biggest Sleeper can turn golden with all its buffs kept, which could run away.
With the Choir firing Wakes twice and the Prior plus Ribica counting them, it is hard to see how many triggers one Wake sets off.
The order of the +1/+1 and the 3 Rest on its Wake isn't written.
